こんにちは、前回はお世話になりました！
是非またイラストのリクエストをさせて頂きたく思い、お送りいたしました！🐶🤍

【内容】コテ同 

【構図/服装】おまかせ

 【雰囲気】青春ぽさがあると嬉しいです！お互いに18歳くらいのイメージてお願いいたします。お互いに邦ロックが好きという共通点がありよく好きなバンドについて話しております。 

【資料】https://42ed08157f826bcdadcf8b61.amebaownd.com/  

もしご機会ございましたら何卒よろしくお願いいたします💫

https://42ed08157f826bcdadcf8b61.amebaownd.com/

うわー、あなたの絵は本当に美しいです私のキャラクターを描いてくれたらうれしいです。リンク先のリファレンスにある緑色の髪のキャラクターです。

売れっ子ロックメタルバンドのベーシストです。一見穏やかな性格に見えるが、実は色気があって、どこか邪悪なところがある。何かを隠しているような、秘密が多いような、そんな感じの人です。

背が高く、大柄な体型で、コルセットを着用した衣装をよく着ている。このリンク先にはたくさんの衣装があるので、あなたが一番好きなものを着て彼を描いてください。https://www.pinterest.com/infesteds/play-destroy-masaki/modern-closet/

このキャラクターは、カマキリ、植物、赤色を強く連想させる。これらのコンセプトは取り入れなくてもいいのですが、このキャラクターがどのようなものか、よくわかるような気がします。また、蜘蛛で表現されたキャラクターとも関連があるので、お望みであれば実装してください。

長い依頼で申し訳ありませんどうぞお好きなように描いてやってください本当にありがとうございました

https://sta.sh/222rx8xx2egu

田中さん初めまして、田中さん独特の画風と雰囲気が大好きで是非私のOCを御依頼したくご連絡させて頂きました！

OCは好きな人から離れたくなくて1人になりたくなくて裏社会に足を踏み入れた軸の子です。この軸のOCは少し情緒不安定気味になってます。好きな人や大事な家族の為なら自己犠牲すら厭わない様な子でもあります。OCの最後は自分の望み通り彼の腕の中で幸せそうに息絶えます。

OC資料では三つ編みをしているのですが今回は、髪を下ろしているもの(三つ編みではない)をお願いしたいです！髪を下ろしている時の参考は資料内のゼペを基本にイラストなどを参考にして頂ければと思います🍀
また、右耳が見えていると嬉しいです。
服装はOC資料のものでも田中さんのお好きな様にして頂いても大丈夫です！

ご縁がありましたら是非とも宜しくお願い致します·͜· ︎︎ᕷ

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-82uEuNT3173qOvPJLqvNnnX43P67ygo

Hello! I came across your art and find it so beautiful and elegant! I really love the colors and shadows, it really gives off such a unique and mysterious feeling. If possible, I would like to request a drawing of my friend's original character!

My character has no specified gender. They can be described as both beautiful and handsome. They are mischievous, curious, and have a very expressive face and body, so it is easy to tell what they are feeling. They often act immature, but are wise when they need to be.

I would like to see them drawn with a smug and youthful expression. In the references provided, please draw according to the image labelled "OUTFIT REFERENCE". The composition is up to you!
https://sta.sh/2syszq6pkqk?edit=1

Thank you very much for your consideration!

https://sta.sh/2syszq6pkqk?edit=1

Hello 𝔗𝔞𝔫𝔞𝔨𝔞俺-sensei! Your art is so wonderful I would like to request you to draw my original character. 

https://sta.sh/2z30xzk2z5k

Amy(🎸) 169 CM is a young and energetic university student! She is friendly and sociable, and a bit girlish. She is adventurous and bold, and does her best to live out her youth to the fullest! She is a very normal girl, who suddenly finds herself in the middle of strangle and paranormal circumstances. Although she is smart and good at studies, she actually wants to pursue music. Her dream is to sing in a band and perform on stage. She plays the guitar, and her favorite food is bubble tea. She has slightly tanned skin and a beauty mark under her right eye.

Keywords: summer, sunsets, footprints on the beach, youth, sunflowers, stagelights, guitar, red

Please remember that she is a bit tan, and her mole. Remember that the roots of her hair are black and the tips are grey. Her main color is black and red. I will leave the composition up to you! Thank you very much!

https://sta.sh/2z30xzk2z5k

Hello! I love your artwork. I would like to request an illustration of my character.

She is a former thief who loves jewelry and birds. Her motifs are cranes and misty oceans. She is quiet and lethargic, and she is fond of high places and trees. You can draw her however you would like! You can draw her in a different outfit if you'd like.

References: https://toyhou.se/18458002.suyin-xu/gallery 

Thank you so much for your consideration!

Nice to meet you, I fell in love with your style at first sight. I would like you to draw a character of my creation if you would like.

I am a girl (18) who lives in an orphanage and has a strong religious belief. I love flowers, novels, and music. I am a girl who loves music. Also, because of the small world she has lived in, she tends to worship those who are kind to her. Currently, she worships a teacher who comes to the orphanage to teach her studies, but she has no romantic feelings for him. That's all for the character description, the rest is all up to you :)

She is tall and heels make her even taller, but she wants to wear heels... I was so happy when the person I liked found out that I was conflicted about wearing heels, but I realized that even if I wore heels, I would never be taller than the person I liked, and he told me that they looked good on me. I am moving slowly toward happiness, even though I am clumsy.

I am happy to leave all the compositions and outfits to you!
